dedupe_keys.name: industryheat eu industrial final and useful energy demand by temperature level for the eu27 and member states

description: IndustryHeat-EU gives final energy consumption and useful energy demand in TWh by type of demand and temperature level for 12 industrial subsectors, for the EU27 and each Member State. The Zenodo record says rows are demand categories (other electricity, thermal electricity, steam and non-electric process heat below 100 C, 100 to 400 C, 400 to 1000 C and above 1000 C) and columns are subsectors such as primary and secondary steel, chemicals, cement, pulp and paper, food, non- ferrous metals and ceramics and glass; it is compiled from the JRC-IDEES 2021 database following the method of Madeddu et al. (2020). It was published on 22 October 2025 (version 1.0.0) by Vladimir Gjorgievski, Snezana Cundeva, Natasa Markovska and Neven Duić as one downloadable zip of about 70 KB, free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is the EU27 at national level. Caveats: the base year follows JRC-IDEES 2021 and is not stated on the page read, and the values are derived, not metered. For simulation it gives temperature-resolved industrial heat demand to test electrification, heat pump and sector coupling scenarios and the load an electrified industry adds to power grids. Related catalogue records include the Hotmaps industrial sites with excess heat and the Hotmaps electricity and district heating scenarios.
